Energy.description: Energy consumption, generation, and distribution documents

Energy Purchase Invoice.extraction_rules: Extract invoice date, supplier, item, HSN/SAC, Quantity / Consumption / Withdrawal, units, gross amount.

Electricity Bill.extraction_rules: Extract electrical parameters only. Ignore charges and taxes.

Electric Consumption History.extraction_rules: Extract monthly consumption values and period.

Electric Meter Reading.extraction_rules: Extract meter readings, MF, KWH, KVAH, KVARH, peak/night hours.

Generation Report.extraction_rules: Extract date range and net generation.

Power Plant Report.extraction_rules: Extract generation, steam, turbine, and fuel-use totals.

Hand Written Power Log.extraction_rules: Extract date, shift, meter readings, and consumption difference.

Hydel Bill Summary.extraction_rules: Extract hydel bill amount and hydel consumption.

Steam Distribution Log.extraction_rules: Extract date, turbine inlet/extraction steam, and distribution values.

Fuel.description: Fuel purchase, stock, quality, and consumption documents

Fuel Purchase Invoice.extraction_rules: Extract invoice date, supplier, item, HSN/SAC, Quantity / Consumption / Withdrawal, units, gross amount.

Diesel Purchase Invoice.extraction_rules: Extract material description, item code, quantity, and HSN.

Gas Bill.extraction_rules: Extract SCM consumption, actual/excess gas, and gas price.

Fuel Stock Register.extraction_rules: Extract fuel name, date, opening balance, received quantity, consumption.

Fuel Stock Summary.extraction_rules: Extract period, fuel type, inwards, outwards, closing balance.

Coal Receipt Register & Quality Register.extraction_rules: Extract date, supplier, GCV, moisture, ash, net weight.

Coal Consignment Report.extraction_rules: Extract month/date range, truck count, moisture, GCV, ash.

Coal Quality Summary.extraction_rules: Extract supplier, weighted GCV/moisture/ash, total coal.

Coal laboratory test report.extraction_rules: Extract report date, sample quantity, GCV, moisture, ash from test results.

Fuel Lab Test Report.extraction_rules: Extract sample name, date, moisture, volatile matter, fixed carbon, GCV.

Belt Conveyor Sample Report.extraction_rules: Extract date, shift, conveyor ID, moisture, ash, GCV.

Daily Fuel Consumption.extraction_rules: Extract date and fuel-wise consumption (rice husk, coal, RDF, bagasse, biomass, diesel).

RDF / Waste Fuel Sampling.extraction_rules: Extract waste type, weight, composition %, GCV, ash, moisture.

Production & Operational.description: Production, boiler, turbine, and process operational logs

Production Summary.extraction_rules: Extract product, period, opening stock, production, dispatch, closing stock.

Machine Consumption Summary.extraction_rules: Extract machine name, production, consumption, power per tonne.

Boiler Log Book.extraction_rules: Extract boiler ID, registration, steam generated, feedwater, shift/day totals.

Turbine Capacity Log.extraction_rules: Extract turbine name/ID, nominal capacity, generation capacity.

Process Log Book.extraction_rules: Extract date, timestamp, pressure, temperature, flow rate, runtime, power, pulp levels.
